blocks.text: MARIVELES, BATAAN, Philippines — A police buy-bust operation that was supposed to target a suspected drug peddler led to the discovery of an alleged drug den inside a residential house along De Guzman Boulevard in Barangay Poblacion on Monday afternoon, Nov. 9. Seven people, whose ages ranged from their mid-20s to 30s, were arrested, according to an initial police report sent to Police Col. Marites Salvadora, Bataan police director. Mariveles police operatives, accompanied by barangay officials, were preparing to conduct the operation after receiving intelligence reports about the presence of a suspected drug peddler in the area.
